name: Frayfeather Highlands
summary: In Feralas, Frayfeather hippogryphs defend their ancestral roosts. Scavengers and naturalists brave the flocks in search of intact eggs.

sections.title: Aerie of the Hippogryphs
sections.body: Wild hippogryphs raise their broods on steep slopes and crags above Feralas's forest floor. The flocks defend their scattered nests among the rock shelves with fierce aggression. Their mastery of the rugged cliffs draws outsiders to the nesting grounds. Goblin entrepreneurs in distant Gadgetzan seek unhatched eggs for study and profit.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Frayfeather Highlands?
faq.answer: Large flocks of wild Frayfeather hippogryphs nest across the high rock faces. They defend their territory fiercely against trespassers.

faq.q: Why are travelers interested in the hippogryph nests?
faq.answer: Rare hippogryph eggs lie in the nests. Adventurers carry viable eggs across Tanaris to Gadgetzan, where goblins process them in the Super Egg-O-Matic for research and profit.

faq.q: Where are the Frayfeather Highlands located?
faq.answer: The highlands rise in southern Feralas above the main jungle canopy. Their craggy hillsides offer open perches for nesting.

angles.text: As a night elf, you revere hippogryphs as sacred companions of Elune. Their wild nests in Feralas deserve protection from reckless exploitation.
As a druid, you hold Kalimdor's wild beasts in high regard. The undisturbed aeries of the Frayfeather Highlands reflect the forest's primal vitality.
